title: Midnight Stealth: Don't Wake Mom!
description: A first-person stealth game in a 3D house at night. Walk, crouch and open doors yourself while a decibel meter and Mom's detectability bar track every creak. Five missions: sneak down for instant ramen, win a secret 3 AM ranked match, grab a food delivery before the doorbell, smuggle a friend in and out, or retrieve your confiscated phone from Mom's nightstand.
